title: Explore: Architecture
description: Trace current Vite React routing, page ownership, and B/C-end separation points.
findings: App.tsx uses hand-rolled pathname routing; WorkbenchLayout owns B-end shell; a standalone mobile route can bypass WorkbenchLayout and avoid touching IDE.
recommendations: Add RouteState kind=mobile and render a new page outside WorkbenchLayout.

title: Explore: Implementation
description: Inspect frontend component style patterns and static prototype requirements.
findings: Existing UI uses React function components, lucide-react icons, Ant Design only where useful, and styles.css global class naming. Prototype requires Home, Catalog, Problem, Code Read, Evidence, Profile.
recommendations: Create apps/web/src/pages/ConsumerMobilePage.tsx plus scoped .consumer* CSS classes.

title: Explore: Performance
description: Check runtime cost and data dependency risk for mobile C-end page.
findings: The first version can be static/read-only and avoids API blocking. Main risk is large CSS and heavy Ant components; using plain React markup and existing lucide icons keeps it light.
recommendations: Avoid fetching catalog data in the mobile prototype route; keep screenshot deterministic.

title: Score: Feasibility
findings: Single frontend subsystem, no backend contract required, route integration is small.

title: Score: Impact
findings: Converts PNG prototype into usable app surface and validates C-end information architecture early.
recommendations: Ship as /mobile prototype page before wiring live data.

title: Score: Risk
description: Score delivery risk; higher means safer/lower risk in this table.
findings: Risk is mainly visual regression and accidental B-end shell coupling. Avoided by standalone route and screenshot verification.
recommendations: Do not add IDE entry; keep code read-only labels explicit.

title: Score: Complexity
description: Score implementation complexity; higher means less complex.
findings: One new page and CSS section, one router branch. No database/API changes.
recommendations: Keep static data local to component for this iteration.

title: Score: Alignment
findings: Matches classified catalog first, official evidence first, copyright-safe summaries, and C++ level-5 MVP.
recommendations: Surface official source/copyright rules in evidence screen.

title: Score: Maintainability
findings: Maintainable if page data is structured arrays and class names are isolated. Risk grows if static markup becomes duplicated.
recommendations: Use small render helpers/arrays where it reduces duplication.

title: Decision Synthesis
description: Compile Go/No-Go and task plan for implementation.
findings: Go. scope_verdict=medium: one frontend subsystem with screenshot verification. Implement /mobile route, mobile page, CSS, build verification, screenshot verification.
recommendations: Next: implement page then run build and browser screenshot.
